requiredLeadershipLinks.question: Which measured persona need exceeds the corporate floor and approved reserve?
What current, persona-specific problem exists in the incumbent fleet?
What did the candidate, incumbent, and sibling or alternative show under the same frozen protocol?
What measured cost or business effect follows, or what is explicitly not yet measured?
What exact buying recommendation follows from the issued verdict and procurement envelope?

readinessRules: Every recommended persona has all five leadership links: persona need, current fleet issue, candidate/control comparison, business effect, and verdict-backed recommendation.

The persona-specific incumbent cohort resolves inside a released, privacy-approved fleet-portfolio snapshot containing exactly the twelve machine-policy dimensions, each with its complete closed claim-metric set and exact source, release, distribution or structured-summary, denominator, coverage, baseline, provenance, freshness, limitation, and requalification bindings.
Persona, incumbent, candidate, control, condition, baseline, and test-pack references resolve with ordinal case-sensitive equality.

Every link derives CURRENT only when observation and admission chronology, the frozen maximum-age policy, source-record equality, and the current BIOS, driver, Windows, corporate-image, security-agent, condition-set, and test-pack dependency snapshot all pass; a caller-supplied CURRENT label is not evidence.
The candidate, incumbent, and sibling or alternative are projections from one frozen manifest and each covers the exact same frozen condition set, protocol, baseline, and test pack.

Every applicable frozen Phase 0 test definition is represented for every required role, condition, and baseline stratum; each distribution binds the exact test-plan reference and digest plus sampling-floor pointer and digest, meets that frozen class floor even when it exceeds the public minimum, and carries a complete typed distribution.
T2 cannot be the sole support for a decision link and every T2 reference resolves to T0 or T1 corroboration.
Every number retains unit, window, denominator, distribution, coverage, missingness, exclusions, and source reference.

The recommendation is deterministically rendered into a non-evidence decision-claim record whose exact statement, source verdict digest, and fleet, persona, and procurement pointers resolve; the derived packet cannot strengthen it.

The executed business-effect machine branch is exactly COST_DELTA, NON_PRICE_EFFECT, or NOT_MEASURED; its status, required fields, forbidden fields, typed record, pointer, window, evidence, commercial basis where applicable, and controlled decision impact all agree without inventing savings or non-price outcomes.

An ISSUED chain has non-null semantic-validation record, result-digest, and canonical input-digest values. The input digest binds the exact portable-contract references, five decision-link values, issuance context, and decision-source record digests; the later derived decision-claim payload binds back to semantic validation and is excluded from its own input digest to prevent a hash cycle.
Public Test-LeadershipClaimChain validation may establish VALIDATED_DERIVED_INPUT only; it cannot issue a packet state, pilot authorization, procurement approval, or purchase decision.

Fleet HOLD or FAIL, persona FAIL, INCONCLUSIVE evidence without the exact deadline-plus-expiring-risk-exception path, unknown component identity, pending delta qualification, expired exception, or unresolved critical risk produces NOT_READY.

Structured arbitration outcome, fleet disposition, persona disposition, procurement action, and every authoritative condition record agree exactly; arbitrary outcome prose cannot override the resolved verdict state.
The packet contains no direct employee, device, tenant, group, ticket, or evidence-store identity.

Every rendered field passes context-aware Markdown, HTML, URL, and CSV encoding, safe-link policy, active-content rejection, control-character and length limits, and spreadsheet-formula neutralization.
A confidence label shows provenance, directness, comparability, coverage, repeatability, and limitations; it never overrides a gate.
